title: Inside the Mind of a Tech Investor with Gavin Baker
description:
An interview with Gavin Baker, Managing Partner and CIO, Atreides Management, LP, at Sohn Investment Conference 2026. The discussion covers his investment philosophy, his perspective on the current AI landscape, and future technological shifts. Moderated by Jas Khaira
Head, Blackstone N1.
summary: The speaker argues that the semiconductor and AI infrastructure sectors are dominated by high-quality, durable businesses that are significantly underappreciated by the market. Key positions include established giants like Nvidia, Google, Broadcom, and Amazon, alongside emerging 'neo cloud' providers such as CoreWeave, Crusoe, and Nebius. The core investment thesis rests on the belief that these companies possess superior technology, efficient utilization rates, and scalable capacity that justifies a bullish stance across the entire group.

claims.claim: The speaker believes Nvidia could sell up to 2 trillion dollars worth of chips next year due to capacity expansion.
claims.quote: And, if they double or triple the capacity, like Nvidia could probably sell 1, 1.5, 2 trillion dollars worth of chips next year. I really believe that.

claims.claim: The speaker notes that Amazon's Trainiums are one of only two functioning switched scale up networks in the world today.
claims.quote: And the only two functioning switched scale up networks in the world today are the ones that power Nvidia's GPUs and Amazon's Trainiums.

claims.claim: The speaker believes the neo cloud category is durable and that CoreWeave GPUs are utilized two to three times more per hour than bottom providers.
claims.quote: And the way to think of running one of these clusters is like driving a Formula 1 race car. You watch Formula 1 You watch these Formula 1 races, and it looks easy. It's like anybody could do it.

claims.claim: The speaker loves Crusoe, believes it is going to work, and states they have a large position in Crusoe.
claims.quote: Uh, I could have Trade Desk could have invested over $50 million in the round at $1.1 billion. And I was conflicted out by Crusoe, and I love Crusoe, and I think Crusoe's going to work, and we have a large position in Crusoe.
claims.speaker: Gavin Baker

claims.claim: The speaker groups Nebius with CoreWeave and Crusoe as high-quality neo clouds with an underappreciated durable business model.
claims.quote: But I think this is very under appreciated. And people think, "Oh, that can't be a durable competitive advantage." Well, I was a retail analyst in the year 2005 and I observed all you had to do to create a $50 billion market cap in America in any category was be able to run 1,000 stores in 50 states with different climates and different, you know, consumer preferences that are staffed by friendly, knowledgeable employees who don't steal from you, that are stocked with the right inventory at the right time at the right prices, and have clean stores that are well-lit.
claims.speaker: Gavin Baker
